name: custom-provider-orchestrator
description: Run custom-provider models as isolated top-level Codex workers without an OpenClaw gateway.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate Codex GPT with custom-provider workers.
interface.longDescription: Routes bounded tasks to custom-provider models through isolated top-level Codex runs. Codex keeps orchestration authority and native tools; workers receive explicit task envelopes, nonces, timeouts, and sandbox limits.
defaultPrompt: Delegate this bounded task to a MiniMax Codex worker.
Check the status of my custom-provider workers.
Ask a custom-provider worker for an independent review.
